name: hover-stack
title: Hover Stack
description: Overlapping card stack that fans out around the hovered card

changelog.summary: Added cards, cardWidth, cardHeight, overlap, pushDistance, and hoverLift as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (items, spread, rotation, duration, accentColor) didn't match this component's real API, so they were replaced with the props HoverStackComp actually accepts.
Disable hover lift/push transforms under reduced motion; keep z-index focus

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Width of each card in pixels.

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Height of each card in pixels.

props.name: overlap
props.description: Horizontal overlap between resting cards in pixels.

props.name: pushDistance
props.description: Distance neighboring cards are pushed aside on hover.

props.name: hoverLift
props.description: Vertical lift applied to the hovered card in pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation amount applied to stacked items.

props.description: Highlight color for active stack content.
